title: For the mountains we have not met yet
message:
My par,

If you're reading this, it means we've added a few more trails to our story. A few more birthdays, a few more summit photos, and probably a few more moments where our legs were completely cooked.

I hope that no matter how many mountains we've climbed since then, we still remember what made all of this special. It was never just about reaching the summit. It was the early mornings, the long walks, the shared silence, the laughter, the struggles, and every step we took side by side.

The best adventure was never the mountain itself.

It was learning how to walk through the world together.
